asked.item: how to add a link sticker to an IG story through the API

verdict.reason: The help pages directly state that the API cannot add link stickers and give the manual workaround of publishing through Blotato and then adding the sticker in the Instagram app.

steps.text: Instagram's API does not support adding link stickers to Stories published through third-party tools, so you cannot add one through the API.
Publish the Story through Blotato as normal.
Then open the Instagram app and add the link sticker manually to the published Story.
